# Previz

> Web-based previsualization tool. A scene is a single JSON document (Previz Spec) or a JavaScript
> "Previz Script" that builds one. Paste either into the app ("✨ AI / 스크립트") to block actors,
> props, cameras, lenses and timing in 3D and render reference video for AI video models.

Output exactly one fenced code block: ```json (Previz Spec) or ```js (Previz Script).

## Docs

- [Scene Spec](/docs/scene-spec.md): document format, conventions (Y-up, meters, seconds, degrees; rotation.y = 0 faces +Z), actions, shots
- [Script API](/docs/script-api.md): `scene.*` builder API for procedural scenes
- [JSON Schema](/schema/previz.schema.json): machine-readable schema (input form, defaults optional)

## Examples

- [Living room, two actors, two cameras](/examples/living-room.json)
